iteration: Eight initial native captures showed side cues merging with Gaper/Horf bodies, especially under Freeze. Enlarged and moved cues outward. Intermediate cue-review captures are retained; all eight verified captures use the final build after the Horf timing fix.
limitations: Isolated fixtures at one camera angle; mixed-room, occlusion, color-vision and varied-zoom acceptance remain open.
Burn uses small stylized cone flames; warm ground still reduces contrast. These are original status cues, not a full particle-art acceptance pass.
Thirty-frame smoke captures demonstrate appearance and probes, not controlled rendered performance. Their FPS display is not a benchmark.
Still images cannot establish animation cadence, frozen movement or full fight balance; automated tests provide the scoped behavior evidence.
